item.title: [LU-12798] sanity-quota test_65: root file system becomes read-only
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for S Buisson <sbuisson@ddn.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/6c2f5ad0-de29-11e9-a197-52540065bddc

test_65 failed with the following error:
